newsitem.title: USA: Gilead files NDA for herpes treatment.
newsitem.headline: Gilead files NDA for herpes treatment.

text.p: Gilead Sciences Inc Monday said it filed a New Drug Application to market Forvade to treat refractory herpes simplex virus infection in patients with AIDS.

Gilead said in a statement, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has accepted the application for review, representing the Agency's opinion that the application is sufficiently complete to permit a substantive review. Acceptance of the NDA by the FDA does not represent any opinion of the Agency regarding the safety, efficacy or clearance of the product, the company said.
